description: IPC the main and overlay windows are allowed to use: core invoke/event plumbing, the dialog plugin's Rust-side API that pick_log_directory calls on the window's behalf, and the updater plugin backing the in-app update check/install flow (restart itself is a core AppHandle call, not a separate plugin). The overlay window only ever calls a few read-only commands and listens for parse-tick/overlay-opacity, but there's no narrower stock permission bundle than core:default to hand it -- see windowcap.rs's own doc for why it exists behind a runtime capability check regardless of what IPC it's allowed.
